column2: David's approaching days of death introduce his command to Solomon; the speech is not presented as a fresh divine oracle.
The way of all the earth and strong/man exhortations retain the mortality idiom and direct human address.
Charge, ways, commandments, statutes and judgments of Moses' law remain, with understanding what to do according to David's commands rather than substituting general prosperity.
Both saying clauses, the conditional obedience with whole heart and soul, and the not-cut-off throne promise remain; no unconditional guarantee replaces the if.
David's two named commanders, war blood in peace and specifically innocent blood on belt and sandal preserve the selected charge against Joab.
Wisdom governs the command, while the negative peaceful descent to Hades retains the severity and gray-hair image.
Mercy to Barzillai's sons, eating at the table and their approach during flight from Solomon's brother Absalom retain all relationships.
Behold introduces Shimei from Bahurim, the painful curse en route to Camps and the Jordan oath; Camps is not replaced with a different place-name.
column3: The ei oath is rendered as a negative assurance. Its first-person active form is kept distinct from the third-person passive in 35n.

column2: The emphatic prohibition of acquittal, wise-man rationale and future knowledge precede bringing gray hair to Hades with blood; no gentler consequence is substituted.
David's sleeping with fathers and burial in his own city retain the conventional death language and explicit burial location.
Forty years is preserved as seven at Hebron and thirty-three at Jerusalem; the extra six months from another account are not inserted.
The selected age twelve and strongly prepared kingdom remain explicit; no age inferred from later chronology replaces twelve.
Adonijah's prostration to Bathsheba and the peace question and reply remain, with his speech continuing into the next unit.
His word-to-you request and her command Speak continue the exchange without a new unexpressed topic.
The claimed prior kingship, all Israel's attention, transfer to his brother and divine-source explanation remain Adonijah's assertions, not an independent narrator's endorsement.
One request and do not turn away your face retain the petition idiom, followed by Bathsheba's permission to speak.
Please speak, the parenthetical confidence in Solomon's response and he will give Abishag as wife retain the petitioner's prediction.
Bathsheba agrees to speak about Adonijah; the promise does not guarantee granting his request.
The king rises, meets and kisses his mother; the kiss is not replaced by a bow. Her separate throne and seat on his right remain.
One small request, the face idiom and the king's promise not to turn her away preserve the dialogic repetition.
Bathsheba's passive request names Abishag, Solomon's brother and marriage, without adding a political explanation to her words.
Solomon's why-question, request for the kingdom too, elder-brother rationale and the named allies retain his interpretation of the petition.
column3: His is a supplied predicate for the elliptical Abiathar clause; the exact coordination of companion with Joab and Abiathar remains open.

column2: The self-imprecatory oath and statement that Adonijah spoke against his own life retain the speaker's judgment, without supplying an omitted curse formula.
The living-Lord oath, prepared king, Davidic throne, made house and promised fulfillment culminate in this-day death.
Solomon's dispatch through Benaiah is rendered causatively had Adonijah killed; the named death that day remains explicit.
column3: The Greek killing verb has an unexpressed subject; the causative English preserves Solomon's responsibility without asserting that he personally struck the blow.

column2: Propose For before the man-deserving-death clause to retain its causal link to the dismissal. The ark-bearing and shared-hardship reasons for sparing Abiathar remain.
Removal from the Lord's priesthood and fulfillment of the word against Eli's house at Shiloh retain office, divine word and location.
Joab's support for Adonijah and lack of support for Solomon remain; Absalom is not substituted for Solomon. Flight and altar horns follow.
Propose and behold, he is holding fast in the report. The fuller royal question, Joab's fear and flight-to-the-Lord answer, and command to kill and bury remain in full.
Come out, the refusal and decision to die here, followed by Benaiah's return and double report, preserve the repeated exchange.
The king commands killing and burial and removal this day of blood shed without cause from himself and his father's house.
The selected past returned remains, together with two better and more righteous victims, David's lack of knowledge and distinct Israel/Judah commands.
column3: Past tense is not changed to will return to match a familiar version or to settle the speech's temporal perspective.

column2: The selected past passive was returned contrasts with the wish for enduring peace to David, descendants, house and throne; all four recipients remain.
Benaiah kills Joab and buries him at his house in the wilderness; the possessive remains without adding a separate tomb or owner.
Benaiah's replacement command, establishment in Jerusalem and Zadok's appointment as first priest remain three separate assertions.
Divine gift of discernment, exceedingly great wisdom and breadth of heart like shore sand retain all three expressions.
The comparison remains with all sons of old and all discerning Egyptians, not an imported reference to eastern peoples.
Pharaoh's daughter, the City of David, both houses, surrounding wall and seven-year completion remain in their selected placement.
column3: The attachment of first and the supplied object them for completion remain provisional; the scope of the seven years is not harmonized with later building durations.

column2: Seventy thousand carriers and eighty thousand mountain stonecutters preserve both workforce counts and different occupations.
Both the initial sea and concluding bronze sea remain in the six-part equipment list; the apparent repetition is not silently removed.
Citadel, battlements, cutting through the city, the daughter's ascent to her house and the repeated citadel-building statement remain.
column3: Cut through leaves the physical work unspecified; no reconstructed gate, road or wall project is inserted.

column2: The selected three whole burnt offerings and peace offerings in the year, incense and house completion remain.
column3: The numeral treis and its scope are retained closely; annual occasions versus offering count remains a specialist question rather than an imported three-times calendar.

column2: Three thousand six hundred overseers of the workers remain, without reconciling the figure to another administrative count.
Assour, Megiddo, Gezer, Upper Beth-horon and Baalath remain in order; Assour is not normalized to Hazor.
The restrictive only after and repeated after these things preserve the building sequence; the skipped letter j is not filled with a new unit.
The repeated instruction is explicitly situated while David lived and gives Shimei's origin as Hebron, retaining its difference from Bahurim in verse 8.
The painful curse and going to Camps repeat the earlier charge without collapsing the separate stored unit.
The ongoing coming down and third-person passive oath he shall not be put to death remain distinct from the earlier active I will not kill you.
column3: The negative realizes the elliptical ei oath idiom; this record does not claim an apparatus resolution of the two forms.

column2: Now, prohibition of acquittal, discerning-man reason, knowing what to do and bloody descent to Hades retain the repeated instruction in full.
Building a Jerusalem house and remaining there are followed by an absolute prohibition on going out anywhere.
Departure and crossing Kidron, emphatic knowledge and death, blood on his head and the explicit same-day oath remain.
column3: This formulation and the later right-or-left wording are preserved separately; no inferred boundary map is supplied.

column2: Shimei approves the word and promises obedience; the stated three-year residence is retained rather than indefinite many days.
After three years, two slaves flee to Achish son of Maacah at Gath; behold marks the report of their location.
Shimei rises, saddles the donkey, seeks the slaves and brings them from Gath, with the repeated going preserved.
The report includes the Jerusalem-to-Gath journey and return of his slaves, not merely Shimei's own return.
The negative question recalls the oath and solemn warning, right-or-left travel and emphatic death; the reported condition is not rewritten to Kidron alone.
The why-question distinguishes the Lord's oath from the command imposed on Shimei, preserving both grounds of accusation.
Solomon invokes Shimei's knowledge and his heart's knowledge of acts against David, then uses the selected past repayment upon his head.
Solomon is blessed and David's throne will be prepared before the Lord for ever remain within the king's speech.
Solomon commands Benaiah, who goes out and kills Shimei; the explicit final death is retained, with Shimei supplied for the contextual pronouns.
Solomon's discernment and wisdom and the great Judah/Israel population retain sand imagery and the three eating, drinking and rejoicing actions.
Rule among all kingdoms, recurring gifts and service throughout his lifetime remain without importing a geographical list here.
Beginning to open Lebanon's resources preserves the inherited interpretation of dynasteumata without adding named forests or mines.
column3: The lexical sense resources versus powers or strongholds remains unresolved; the retained rendering is not a technical identification.

column2: Thermai in the wilderness remains the selected name, without harmonizing it to Tamar or Tadmor.
The full meal inventory retains thirty and sixty kors, ten calves, twenty cattle and one hundred sheep, plus deer, gazelles and birds.
column3: Midday meal is an interpretive rendering of ariston, not a verified hour. The birds' pasture-fed descriptor and exact species remain open; no extra game category is inserted.

column2: For links the provisioning to rule beyond the River from Raphi to Gaza and among all its kings; Raphi is retained.
Surrounding peace, secure individual vine and fig tree, eating and drinking, Dan-to-Beersheba extent and all Solomon's days remain.
All nine officials and their stated roles remain, including Abi son of Joab in military command and Benaiah over court administration and brickworks.
column3: Selected names and office assignments are not harmonized with chapter 4; the technical meanings of burdens, court administration and brickworks remain provisional.

column2: Forty thousand broodmares for chariots and twelve thousand horsemen retain number, sex and purpose, without replacing mares with stalls.
Rule among kings from the River to foreigners' land and Egypt's borders remains distinct from the Raphi-to-Gaza statement.
The final notice names Solomon son of David reigning over both Israel and Judah in Jerusalem, completing all selected lettered units.
